changelog: Added Global System Prompt in Settings → Agents → System prompt (and a "Set Global" button in the chat 🧠 System Prompt dialog): applies automatically to every chat without its own override, while chats with custom overrides always keep theirs

Improved the chat 🧠 System Prompt dialog: "Active Prompt" now shows the real active prompt (Per-chat override, Global system prompt, or Agent default) with clear source labels and a didactic guide comparing System Prompt vs. Global Context

Chat System Prompt now genuinely replaces Antigravity's default <identity> and persona via CustomAgentConfig (exclude_default_components = true) with AGENT_MESSAGE_ORIGIN_SDK_EXECUTABLE, preserving all native coding tools without repeating the prompt on every user message

Cleaned up Antigravity chat context noise via CustomizationDiscoveryConfig: disabled unused built-in skills, plugins, subagents, rules, hooks, workflows, and isolated jarvis_mcp from normal chats while keeping user-enabled MCPs active

Fixed the "CustomAgentSpec is only allowed to specify builtin_agent" delivery error on chats with a Chat System Prompt: the prompt is now injected hidden in front of the message and framed as replacing the default persona
Fixed "Rewind & resend" on the first message of a chat: its text (and files) now land in the message box instead of being wiped when the chat switches to a fresh one
Much faster CI/release builds: arm64 and x86_64 build in parallel on separate runners, unit tests and Go tests run alongside, and the Go bridge build is now incremental and cacheable
Fixed user message editing showing hidden <lytsocoder-expansion> / <antigem-expansion> app context blocks instead of only the user's message
Swapped Rewind & resend and Save in place buttons in the user message edit dialog
Introduced minimalist Neon Rainbow terminal (>_ ) logo unified across launcher icon, splash animation, and README
Added special Rainbow AMOLED dark theme with true #000000 AMOLED surfaces and prismatic neon UI accents
Published signed non-debug Release APKs for both arm64 and x86_64
Added x86_64 support for emulators and Chromebooks (-Pabi=x86_64, per-ABI glibc runtime, seccomp shim, Linux x64 agy launcher)
Synced multi-account AGY switcher, EGM (/egm), Gemmy mascot, Pinned Chats, and Compose BOM 2026.11.01
Kept Enhanced Conversation Control and Android 11+ seccomp-safe Go bridge process management (pkg/procutil)
